headline: Yoro was sent off after 8 minutes of Pochettino's first game; from then on Liverpool had 25 shots and 3.98 xG to United's 9 and 0.59, and won 4-0 with 7 big chances to United's 0.

turning_point.event: Leny Yoro straight red card, denial of an obvious goalscoring opportunity (foul on Isak just outside the box)

facts.fact: United's earliest red card in the Premier League
facts.source: https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cq7827p8emmxo image caption: 'The sending-off after eight minutes was Manchester United's earliest red card in the Premier League' (data/research/scrape_e1535da10a3b.json)

facts.fact: Szoboszlai scored the resulting free-kick at 10' (0.20 xG); Wirtz made it 2-0 at 13'
facts.source: BBC report in https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cm62pqqw6d29t ('Dominik Szoboszlai stepped up to send the free-kick into the bottom left corner'); shots_espn.json shots 5 and 7

facts.fact: Kop chanted 'sacked in the morning' 13 minutes into Pochettino's first game

Verdict split: BBC's Dale Johnson calls it 'a borderline case' and says Yoro 'can count himself a little unfortunate'; ESPN's VAR review calls it 'a straightforward decision'. Neville: 'It's so clumsy from Yoro.'

tactical_change.after: 10 men; shape after the change not stated by any source
tactical_change.trigger: red card (Yoro 8') then Maguire on for Mbeumo at 22' (BBC + ESPN line-ups)
tactical_change.effect: Between the red card and Maguire's arrival (8'-22') Liverpool had 4 shots, 0.88 xG and scored twice. From 22' to half-time: 5 shots, 0.40 xG, no goals, so the extra centre-back stopped the bleeding until the break. After half-time Liverpool had 16 shots and 2.70 xG and scored twice more.

tactical_change.confidence: medium (sub minute and numbers solid; the 22'-45' period is short and the shape after the sub is not in any source)

best_player.name: Florian Wirtz
best_player.why: Scout's pick. Scored the second (13'), assisted Muñoz's fourth (82'), and created 5 of Liverpool's 7 big chances (highest xA on the pitch, 1.08). ESPN commentary: 'having one of his best games in a Liverpool shirt'; named a standout with Ngumoha in the FT summary.
best_player.source: https://www.espn.co.uk/football/player-stats/_/gameId/401878755 (data/research/scrape_c3f32da84d0c.json, Wirtz row: TCH 76, G 1, A 1, xG 0.36, xA 1.08, SOG 1, SHOT 2, BCC 5); team BCC 7 from https://www.espn.com/soccer/team-stats/_/gameId/401878755; ESPN commentary 82' (data/research/scrape_873659298bd4.json)

worst_player.name: Matheus Cunha
worst_player.why: Scout's pick among players with 45+ minutes (Yoro played 8, so he is not eligible). United's lone starting forward had 21 touches, no shot and 0.01 xA before being replaced at half-time. Context: United played with 10 men from the 8th minute, so this is a low-impact pick, not an anger pick.
worst_player.source: https://www.espn.co.uk/football/player-stats/_/gameId/401878755 (data/research/scrape_c3f32da84d0c.json, Cunha row: TCH 21, G 0, A 0, xG 0.00, xA 0.01, SOG 0, SHOT 0); BBC line-ups 'substituted for J. Zirkzee at 46 minutes' (data/research/scrape_b0f3ea25478b.json)

caveats: No player ratings on the web path: best/worst are Scout's pick from ESPN player stats.
Yoro (8 minutes) is not eligible for worst player under the 45-minute rule; he is recorded as red_card_player.
Red-card verdict is disputed (BBC 'borderline', ESPN 'straightforward'): the reel should not call it wrong or right.
ESPN FT summary mentions 'De Ligt's error' before the red; BBC describes an Araujo long ball and Isak's heavy touch. Not used.
ESPN commentary is cached only from 65' to FT; first-half events come from BBC and the shot map.
Zirkzee's entry: BBC 46', ESPN 45'. Use 'at half-time'.
ESPN commentary says United xG 0.64; header, shot map and BBC say 0.63. Use 0.63.
